subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-02T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion and helpful questions from the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum.

Demo highlights (what the committee cared about):
- Performance/latency at scale (esp. peak promo traffic) — ACME target: p95 < 120ms for common text gen paths.
- Cost predictability (combination of reserved capacity + burst model).
- Data controls / compliance: SOC 2, VPC/private deployment options, and KMS integration.
- Decision criteria: latency, predictable unit economics, and SSOT for access controls.

Stakeholder mapping (from todays call):
- Economic buyer: Jordan Miles (CFO) — owning budget/ROI signoff.
- Security reviewer: Priya Shah (Head of InfoSec) — will run SOC 2 questionnaire and legal ops.
- Procurement/legal: Kavita Rao (Procurement) — commercial T&Cs and vendor onboarding.
- Day-2 ops: Kavita & engineering will coordinate with our solutions engineer if they go to a private deployment.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) We share SOC 2 summary, short technical FAQ, and a MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (MAP) for procurement + timeline — attached. (Action: me — by EOD tomorrow)
2) Priya to confirm any additional compliance artifacts needed (e.g., encryption attestations, audit logs). (Action: Priya)
3) Kavita to send standard PO process and draft T&Cs to review; we can include a commercial term sheet for reserved capacity. (Action: Kavita)
4) Schedule a procurement/technical alignment call with Jordan, Priya, Kavita, and our Solutions Engineer (Ben) next week to align on timeline and handoffs. Proposed slots: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. (Action: Marissa to schedule)

Attachments included: Redwood_Security_Summary_2025.pdf, pricing-summary-acme.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-acme.docx

If that matches your view, I’ll send the MAP and a one-page pricing term sheet and lock a meeting.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: RE: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks team — looping in a couple clarifications from engineering/solutions: 
- POC scoping: we recommend a 3-week technical POC focusing on the busiest inference path (recommend sampling 3–5 representative prompts). POC deliverables: latency report, cost estimate at observed QPS, and integration checklist.
- Reserved capacity timing: typical lead time once commercial terms agreed is ~2–3 weeks to provision dedicated pools in us-west region; private/VPC deployments can add extra provisioning and networking steps (estimate +1–2 weeks depending on network approvals).
- For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and can do an HSM-backed flow on private deployments.

I’ll attach a short MAP template for the procurement process. Marissa — I can host the technical kickoff on Tue 10:30 PT next week if that works for the committee.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
